肥鱼笔记 0.3.3，支持 Android 8.0 及以上。项目仍处于早期预览阶段。

- 课程新增复习记录：在已完成的问答或笔记上点击「加入复习」，确认后保存；也可在课程复习页手工新增。
- 支持编辑、删除、按状态筛选，以及标记「待复习」「已理解」「仍有疑问」。可回到原问答或笔记；来源删除后保留复习文字，并显示「来源已删除」。
- 记录按课程隔离，全部复习操作在本地完成，不额外调用模型。升级时保留现有课程、笔记、照片和设置。

通过[独立下载页](https://feiyunote.cangming.fyi/feiyu/)或本页下方的 APK 覆盖安装。0.3.2 用户也可在设置的「关于与帮助」中检查更新。数据保存在本地，提问时所选内容会发送给 DeepSeek。

欢迎[提出功能建议](https://github.com/Yongzhaooo/FeiyuNote/issues/new?template=feature.yml)；贡献代码前请通过 Issue 确认范围，详见[贡献指南](https://github.com/Yongzhaooo/FeiyuNote/blob/main/CONTRIBUTING.md)。

Feiyu Notes 0.3.3 is an early preview for Android 8.0+.

- Add completed answers or notes to course review records, or create records manually.
- Edit, delete, filter by status, and mark Pending / Understood / Still confused. Return to the original answer or note; if the source is deleted, the review text remains with a source-deleted marker.
- Review records stay within their course. Review operations run locally without extra model requests. Upgrading preserves existing courses, notes, photos and settings.

Install over your current version from the [independent download page](https://feiyunote.cangming.fyi/feiyu/) or the APK below. In 0.3.2, you can also check for updates in Settings → About and help. Data stays on your device; selected content is sent to DeepSeek when you ask a question. See the [README](https://github.com/Yongzhaooo/FeiyuNote/blob/main/README.en.md) and the [contribution guide](https://github.com/Yongzhaooo/FeiyuNote/blob/main/CONTRIBUTING.md#english).
